visual.name: atlasScatter
visual.description: Scatter, bubble and dot plot with play axis, quadrants, trend and ratio lines, clusters and drag to zoom, plus a Gantt chart, with flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Details_Desc: Scatter: one point per value, for example Store.
en-US.Role_Legend_Desc: Colors points by group. Gantt: the phase.
en-US.Role_Play_Desc: Animates the scatter through the values, for example Year.
en-US.Role_End_Desc: Gantt: leave blank for a milestone.
en-US.Landing_Line1: Scatter: add a field to Values (details), and measures to X-axis and Y-axis (and Size for bubbles). Add a Play axis to animate.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Gantt: add Task, Start date and End date (blank for a milestone), and optionally Legend (phase), Owner and % complete.
en-US.Need_Tasks: Add Task, Start date and End date for a Gantt chart.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There is more data than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual
